annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires that any implementation advertising RSASSA‑PSS support must be able to accept RSASSA‑PSS signatures even when TLS 1.2 is negotiated. The phrase “advertise support for RSASSA‑PSS” refers to the supported_signature_algorithms extension, and the requirement is clear and complete.
